description: This file provides a Go implementation for reading and parsing process memory usage information from /proc/[pid]/statm in Linux systems. It defines a ProcStatm struct, methods to retrieve and parse memory data, and functions to convert page counts to bytes.

classes.name: ProcStatm
classes.description: Struct representing memory usage information for a process, including fields for size, resident set size, shared pages, text, library, data, and dirty pages.

methods.name: NewStatm
methods.description: Returns current process memory info; deprecated in favor of p.Statm().

methods.name: Statm
methods.description: Reads and parses /proc/[pid]/statm to retrieve memory usage data.

methods.name: parseStatm
methods.description: Parses byte data from /proc/[pid]/statm into a slice of uint64 values.

methods.name: SizeBytes
methods.description: Converts total program size from pages to bytes.

methods.name: ResidentBytes
methods.description: Converts resident set size from pages to bytes.

methods.name: SHRBytes
methods.description: Converts shared pages from pages to bytes.

methods.name: TextBytes
methods.description: Converts text (code) size from pages to bytes.

methods.name: DataBytes
methods.description: Converts data + stack size from pages to bytes.
